name: Vosmoy den nedeli
source:
The events of the mod take place on the eighth day of the shift, after Semyon fails to get out of Sovenok on the bus.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=506740780]Steam[/url]]
translation:
该模组的事件发生在轮班的第八天，当时谢苗未能乘坐公共汽车离开索维诺克。
